projectDescription: A self-hosted homelab infrastructure built on Proxmox VE, featuring Docker services, internal DNS, reverse proxy, VPN access, observability tooling, and automation scripts.
keyFeatures: Proxmox VE hypervisor with LXC containers and VMs
Internal DNS with Technitium (adblocking, split DNS, wildcards)
Nginx Proxy Manager for reverse proxy and SSL termination
Tailscale VPN for secure remote access
Docker platform with Portainer, Dashy, and monitoring stack
Observability with Grafana, Prometheus, Uptime Kuma, and Speedtest Tracker
Automation scripts for backups, Docker cleanup, and inventory updates
Persistent NFS-backed storage shared between Proxmox and Docker VM
publicApiSurface: compose/dashy — Dashy dashboard Docker Compose stack
compose/speedtest-tracker — Speedtest Tracker Docker Compose stack
compose/uptime-kuma — Uptime Kuma Docker Compose stack
